name: Find Hybrid-Similarity Pair Leads
jtbd: When I have a scoped collection of source-linked records, compare lexical structure with semantic similarity and rank unusual pairs for investigation.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
requires: Optional local model or precomputed dense vectors for a dense semantic leg; otherwise explicitly labeled lexical-only degradation
limitations: HSI and spectral outputs are exploratory portfolio-relative signals, not probability, quality, market, or novelty estimates.
Without a configured local encoder or supplied vectors, the engine explicitly falls back to a lexical-only comparison.
The copied HSI reference source has unresolved redistribution rights and is local-evaluation only.
The whitespace-to-taxonomy workflow is not included in this capability.
